name: The Pinball Arcade
description:
Pinball Arcade is the most realistic and comprehensive pinball simulation ever created!

Play digital versions of over 35 real pinball tables including Mary Shelley's Frankenstein™, Ghostbusters™ Premium, Star Trek™ Vengeance Premium, Mustang® Premium "Boss", Doctor Who Master of Time, Wipeout™, and Tee'd Off™!
